plainText:
(Japanese: コハルとイーブイ　しんかのきせき and - The Miracle of Evolution) is the 119th episode of , and the 1,204th episode of the Pokémon animated series. It first aired in Japan on July 29, 2022.

 

==Plot==
Chrysa and Mimey host the first episode of " Channel", which focuses on Chloe and her non-evolving . They go through some trivia, recap how Chloe and her Eevee came to be together, go through their meetings with all of Eevee's Evolutions, and also wonder where their journey could take them next.

In 's base, the narrator hosts a new radio show, reading through listener mail. The letters of the day come from Professor Cerise, Ren, and Chrysa, who talk about how much Chloe has grown and traveled ever since Eevee became her partner. The clip show ends with an "Eevee Fortunes" segment that designates each Eevee Evolution with a lucky item.

==Trivia==
 " artwork for this episode]]
This is the first since DP120, 618 episodes earlier.
This is also the first regular broadcasting clip show that didn't air as the second episode of a one-hour special since AG120, 810 episodes earlier.
If flashbacks are not counted, this is the first episode since his debut in which Goh does not make an appearance, and the second one in which and are absent.
This is also the first main series episode in which no main character appears outside of flashbacks.
This is also the first regular broadcasting clip show in which Ash and Pikachu are physically absent.
The radio broadcast references the opening theme of , One, Two, Three.
There is no eyecatch for this episode.
Chrysa reads the title card for this episode.
Chloe, Professor Cerise, and narrate the preview for the next episode.
As a clip show, this episode was not dubbed into any other language, and was not aired anywhere outside of Japan.
